_about: One edition of the app: its name, welcome page, quotes, colours and the voices
reflections draw on. The library of quotable works is sources.json in this folder,
and Claude's instructions are in prompts/. Choose the edition with the EDITION
description: A private journal, with a thoughtful reflection after every entry.
lead: A quiet place to write each day, with a thoughtful reflection waiting after every entry.

points.title: Build a habit of daily personal reflection
points.text: A few minutes of writing a day. Your streak keeps count, and a prompt is there when the page feels blank.

points.title: Ground yourself in over two millennia of Western philosophy
points.text: Draw wisdom from classical virtue ethics, Stoicism, medieval scholasticism, Enlightenment thought, and modern existentialism—with direct links to original texts.

points.title: Explore past reflections with prompted questions
points.text: Every reflection ends with a question to carry forward. Browse back by date, or keep favourites close.

points.title: A fully private, encrypted journal
points.text: Entries are locked with a passphrase only you know. Download your whole journal at any time.

welcome_quote.text: “The unexamined life is not worth living.”

passphrase_quote.text: “Thought and speech are the same thing, except that what we call thought is a silent dialogue of the soul with itself, taking place without the voice.”
